profile.Name: Big Grim
profile.Personality: The vicious, short-tempered boss of the Hounds. She threatens to feed her enemies to the dogs or cut their eyes out, and she is proud that the Hounds cannot be bought.
profile.Backstory: Boss of the Hounds. She leads the Hounds from their den in Shark. Would-be recruits must first see Ears to smooth things over, and she sends new members to smuggle hash into the United Cities.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Snarling threats about dogs and dog meat; cackles when hurt; calls her gang her hounds.
